T: One more round. One more plate.
D: Retired and running a restaurant in Philadelphia, Rocky feels the old itch when a computer says he could have beaten the current champ.
P: Serve the snacks when Rocky works the tables at Adrian's, telling the old fight stories.
S: passed round while Rocky works the room

Cook 250g arborio rice in 750ml hot vegetable stock with 1 diced onion and 20g butter for 18 minutes, stir in 40g parmesan and 80g peas, spread out and chill 1 hour. Roll into 12 balls around cubes of 100g mozzarella, roll in flour, beaten egg and 100g breadcrumbs. Fry at 175C for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with 250ml warm passata simmered with garlic and basil.
Lucky Seven Tiger Bar hot honey wings
bar food at the Lucky Seven, where Rocky finds Little Marie again

Toss 1kg chicken wing pieces with 1 tbsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp garlic powder and bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 1 tsp chilli flakes and 2 tbsp hot sauce, add a squeeze of lemon, and toss the wings through.
M: the dish Rocky tells his stories over, table by table

Pound 4 thin slices beef topside (600g). Mix 60g pecorino, 40g breadcrumbs, 2 garlic cloves, a handful of parsley and 30g pine nuts. Lay prosciutto on each slice, spread with the filling, roll and tie. Brown in oil, soften 1 onion, add 1.4 litres passata and basil and simmer the rolls covered for 1 and a half hours. Cook 200g polenta in 1 litre water with 40g butter and 40g parmesan. Slice the braciole and serve over polenta with the gravy.
Adrian's own recipe, the way she cooked it on Tusculum Street

Chicken braised with tomato, capsicum, mushrooms, olives and rosemary, with crusty bread. Season the chicken and brown skin side down in the oil. Lift out. Fry the sliced onion, capsicum, mushrooms and garlic for 6 minutes. Add the tomatoes and rosemary, put the chicken back skin side up and simmer, half covered, for 35 minutes. Stir in the olives, scatter with parsley and serve with torn bread.
W: Little Marie runs the front of house now, and the cheesecake

Beat 900g ricotta with 150g caster sugar, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 orange and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time and 2 tbsp plain flour. Pour into a buttered and floured 23cm springform tin and bake at 160C for 1 hour. Cool in the turned-off oven with the door ajar for 1 hour, then chill 4 hours. Dust with icing sugar.
K: Lucky Seven Tiger Bar whisky sour
poured where Marie tends bar, the night Rocky walks in

Dissolve 60g caster sugar in 60ml hot water and cool. Shake 180ml rye whiskey, 90ml lemon juice, the syrup and 1 egg white without ice, then again hard with ice. Strain into 4 glasses over ice, dot with bitters and add a cocktail cherry.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and chill the risotto up to 2 days ahead; roll and crumb up to 1 day ahead, or freeze crumbed up to 1 month; fry on the night

steps.text: Melt the butter and soften the onion. Stir in the rice, then add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until the rice is tender.
Stir in the parmesan, peas and salt and pepper. Spread on a tray and chill until firm.
Roll into 12 balls, pushing a cube of mozzarella into the middle of each and sealing it in.
Roll each in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil to 175C. Meanwhile simmer the passata with the garlic and basil.
Fry the arancini in batches for 4 minutes until deep golden. Drain.
Serve hot with the warm tomato sauce.

dishes.n: Lucky Seven Tiger Bar hot honey wings
dishes.make_ahead: Mix the hot honey butter up to 1 week ahead; season the wings up to 1 day ahead, uncovered in the fridge so the skin dries; bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Pat the wings very dry and toss with the baking powder, salt and garlic powder.
Spread on a rack over a tray and bake, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Melt the butter with the honey, chilli flakes and hot sauce and add a squeeze of lemon.
Toss the hot wings in the honey butter and serve.

veg.n: Lucky Seven Tiger Bar hot honey cauliflower
veg.make_ahead: Mix the hot honey butter up to 1 week ahead; cut the cauliflower up to 1 day ahead; batter and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C and line a tray with oiled baking paper. Whisk the flour, garlic powder, salt and water into a batter.
Dip the florets in the batter, then in the panko, and spread on the tray. Drizzle with the oil.
Bake, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Melt the butter with the honey, chilli flakes and hot sauce and add a squeeze of lemon.
Toss the hot cauliflower in the honey butter and serve.

dishes.make_ahead: Braise the braciole up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled in the gravy, it slices better cold; make the polenta on the night

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 2 crushed for the filling, 2 sliced for the gravy

steps.text: Mix the pecorino, breadcrumbs, crushed garlic, parsley, pine nuts and pepper.
Pound the beef slices thin between baking paper. Lay a slice of prosciutto on each, spread with the filling, roll up tightly and tie with kitchen string.
Brown the rolls all over in the oil in a heavy pot. Lift out.
Soften the onion and sliced garlic in the same pot, add the passata and half the basil, return the rolls and simmer, covered, on low, turning now and then.
Bring the water to the boil with salt, whisk in the polenta and cook, stirring, until thick, then beat in the butter and parmesan.
Cut the string off the braciole, slice thickly and serve over the polenta with plenty of gravy and the rest of the basil.

veg.n: Adrian's eggplant braciole with soft polenta
veg.make_ahead: Grill and roll the eggplant and make the gravy up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; bake and make the polenta on the night

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 2 crushed for the filling, 2 sliced for the gravy

steps.text: Brush the eggplant slices with 3 tbsp of the oil, season and grill in a hot pan until soft and marked.
Mix the pecorino, breadcrumbs, crushed garlic, parsley, pine nuts and pepper.
Spread the filling and a little mozzarella over each eggplant slice and roll up.
Soften the onion and sliced garlic in the rest of the oil, add the passata and half the basil and simmer.
Heat the oven to 190C. Sit the rolls in a baking dish, pour over the gravy and bake.
Bring the water to the boil with salt, whisk in the polenta and cook, stirring, until thick, then beat in the butter and parmesan.
Serve the rolls over the polenta with plenty of gravy and the rest of the basil.

dishes.make_ahead: Make up to 2 days ahead and reheat; it is better the next day

steps.text: Season the chicken and brown skin side down in the oil. Lift out.
Fry the sliced onion, capsicum, mushrooms and garlic for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and rosemary, put the chicken back skin side up and simmer, half covered, for 35 minutes.
Stir in the olives, scatter with parsley and serve with torn bread.

veg.n: Adrian's mushroom and white bean cacciatore
veg.make_ahead: Make up to 2 days ahead and reheat; it is better the next day

steps.text: Brown the halved mushrooms in the oil.
Add the sliced onion, capsicum and garlic for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, beans and rosemary and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the olives, scatter with parsley and serve with torn bread.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled, it needs at least 4 hours in the fridge; dust with icing sugar just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160C. Butter a 23cm springform tin and dust it with a little of the flour.
Beat the ricotta, caster sugar, both zests and the vanilla until smooth.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the rest of the flour.
Pour into the tin and bake until set at the edges with a slight wobble in the middle.
Turn the oven off and leave the cake inside with the door ajar to cool slowly.
Chill until cold and set.
Dust with the icing sugar and cut into wedges.

dishes.n: Lucky Seven Tiger Bar whisky sour
dishes.make_ahead: Make the sugar syrup up to 1 week ahead in the fridge; shake to order

steps.text: Stir the sugar into the hot water until dissolved.
Cool the syrup.
Shake the whiskey, lemon juice, syrup and egg white hard without ice.
Add half the ice and shake hard again.
Strain into 4 glasses over the rest of the ice, dot the foam with the bitters and add a cherry.

af.n: Lucky Seven Tiger Bar smoky lemon sour
af.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea and make the sugar syrup up to 3 days ahead, both in the fridge; shake to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and stir in the vanilla.
Stir the sugar into the hot syrup water until dissolved.
Chill the tea and syrup until cold.
Shake the tea, lemon juice, syrup and egg white hard without ice.
Add half the ice and shake hard again.
Strain into 4 glasses over the rest of the ice, twist an orange zest strip over each, dust with a pinch of cinnamon and add a cherry.
